notes: All tuning for the ring-escape format lives here, never in code. Distances are px in the 1080x1920 frame, angles in degrees, time in seconds. Re-run `python escape/engine.py --survey 100` after editing to see how durations and per-ring timings move.

rings.notes: gap_deg is per ring, inner first; its length is the ring count. All gaps start lined up at t=0. Ring i spins at spin_deg_per_sec + spin_step * i, so the gaps slowly drift apart: early on the ball flies through several aligned rings at once, later each ring has to be escaped alone. Negative spin turns the other way. boss_push_px adds radial space before the last shape.boss_rings rings, so they read as a final wall.

shape.notes: What engine.score() rewards. The hook wants at least hook_rings rings broken inside hook_seconds (the aligned gaps make it a burst). The last boss_rings are the boss; every ring between is the middle.
